Finding submitted.

**Summary — AUDIT: deviation (fallback cure proposed)**

- **Responsive clauses reviewed:** §6.11 Audit (p0419) — the only audit right binding AbbVie; §6.12 Audit Dispute (p0420) and the "Audit Expert" definition (p0075); §6.13 Confidentiality (p0421); and §3.8.5/3.8.6 records-inspection rights (p0331–p0332), which run in *our* favour and were therefore not flagged.
- **What is already sound:** independent nationally recognised accounting firm reasonably acceptable to us, scope limited to books and records (no systems access), confidentiality imposed by §6.13, and a default that Harpoon bears the cost.
- **Why it fails fallback:** frequency period, prior notice and the cost-shift variance threshold are all left open, so as drafted the clause permits repeated, unannounced audits and cost-shifting on any variance.
- **Cure (3 surgical replacements in §6.11):** fifteen (15) days' prior written notice; no more than once in any twelve (12) month period; Harpoon bears cost unless underpayment exceeds ten percent (10%). Each fallback element mapped once; §6.12's dispute-cost allocation noted in the rationale rather than redlined to keep the edit minimal.
